title: Two Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target.
hints: Think about what information you want to remember as you scan the array once.
A hash map can help you find the complement in constant time.

title: Valid Parentheses
prompt: Given a string containing only brackets, determine whether the input string is valid.
hints: A stack is a natural fit for tracking unmatched opening brackets.
Each closing bracket should match the latest opening bracket.
